root.name: エヌベント・エレクトリック

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: AZZ
companies.sub: 亜鉛めっき・金属塗装

relations.text: 出資先AVAILの電気製品事業(配電盤・バスダクト)をnVentが約9.75億ドルで買収
relations.text_en: nVent bought the electrical products businesses of AVAIL, in which AZZ held a stake, for about $975 million

source.label: AZZ 10-K(2025年2月期)
source.quote: entered into a definitive agreement to sell the electrical enclosures, switchgear, and bus systems businesses (the "Electrical Products Group") of AVAIL to nVent Electric plc ("nVent"), for a purchase price of $ 975

companies.name: ブルックフィールド・ビジネス・パートナーズ

relations.text: nVentの熱管理事業(現Chemelex)を買収
relations.text_en: Acquired nVent's thermal management business, now Chemelex

source.label: Brookfield Business Partners 発表(2025年4月)
source.quote: completed the acquisition of the Thermal Management Business of nVent Electric plc (the "company" or "Chemelex")

source.label: nVent 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On May 18, 2023, as part of our Electrical Connections reporting segment, we completed the acquisition of ECM Investors, LLC, the parent of ECM Industries, LLC ("ECM Industries"), for approximately $1.1 billion in cash.

source.label: nVent 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On July 16, 2024, we completed the acquisition of Trachte, LLC ("Trachte") as part of our Systems Protection reporting segment, for approximately $0.7 billion in cash.

relations.text: 最大の競合をnVentの熱管理部門と記載(現在は売却済み)
relations.text_en: Called nVent's thermal management segment its most significant competitor (since sold)

source.label: Thermon 10-K(2024年3月期)
source.quote: Our most significant competitor is the thermal management segment of nVent Electric plc (NYSE: NVT).

companies.name: フォージェント・パワー・ソリューションズ

relations.text: 産業向け市場でnVentと競合
relations.text_en: Competes with nVent in the industrial market

source.label: Forgent Power Solutions 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: In the Industrial market, we compete with nVent Electric plc;

relations.text: 安全・インフラ分野の競合にnVentを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names nVent among competitors in safety and infrastructure

source.label: Atkore 10-K(2024年9月期)
source.quote: Safety & Infrastructure : Zekelman Industries, Inc., Eaton Corporation plc, ABB Ltd., Hubbell Incorporated, nVent Electric plc., and Haydon Corporation

relations.text: 電化事業の主な競合にnVentを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names nVent among principal competitors of its Electrification business

source.label: ABB 20-F(2023年度)
source.quote: The Electrification Business area's principal competitors vary by product group and include Atkore, Chint, Eaton, Hager, Hubbell, Legrand, LS Electric, Mitsubishi Electric, nVent, Panasonic, Schneider Electric, Siemens and Vertiv.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
